title: Add cleaner.squeeze_ws next to replace_ws
prompt:
The package cleaner in the current directory has `replace_ws(text, insert)` (cleaner/ws.py), which replaces every whitespace character with `insert`. Add, next to it,

    squeeze_ws(text, insert=" ", keep_newlines=False)

and export it from the package (`from cleaner import squeeze_ws`). Behaviour:
- "Whitespace" means exactly the six characters replace_ws treats as whitespace: tab, carriage return, vertical tab, space, form feed and line feed. Any other character (for example U+00A0 or U+2003) is ordinary text and is kept as it is.
- Leading and trailing whitespace is removed.
- Every other maximal run of whitespace becomes one `insert`. With keep_newlines=True, a run that contains at least one line feed becomes a single "\n" instead.
- `insert` may be any string, including "" or several characters.

`replace_ws` and `count_words` must keep their current behaviour. tests/test_cleaner.py has a few examples (run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`); a hidden suite checks the full behaviour. Do not modify tests/test_cleaner.py.
